k_note: plan: cheap models x k (cascade self-agreement), expensive/frontier x1; seeds 1-4 may be added later for expensive/frontier only if the version fingerprint is unchanged
prompt: benchmark default (inspect template) + SF's built-in Model instruction; no custom prompt

notes.seeds: one seed per sample: seed is in SF's cache key, so k seeds = k real calls, not k cache hits
notes.temperature: 1.0 everywhere. OpenRouter lists no temperature support for gpt-5.6-* and claude-*; they sample at their own default (1.0). Set explicitly for gemini/qwen so all models match
notes.max_tokens: high ceiling so medium-effort reasoning does not cut off the ANSWER line; billing is per token used. For budget-based providers (Anthropic, Gemini) the thinking budget may scale with max_tokens; the Day 6 pilot measures it
notes.agreement: per case: modal answer over k samples; agreement = count(mode)/k; opt-out ('Insufficient information') counts as its own answer; ties broken by lowest seed
